name: vrooli_launcher

launcher.rationale: The safeguard installs the POSIX launcher on Linux and macOS.

storage.rationale: The launcher is an explicitly verified host installation artifact.

description: Install a POSIX shim at /usr/local/bin/vrooli so `sudo vrooli` works. See package doc for design rationale.

linux.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

macos.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

windows.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.
